{"id":1567313222,"question_id":2685,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 4 months","timestamp":1741460967,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"8 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1567313222/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"First Completely Painted Row or Column","memory":"134 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    #define pairing pair<int,int>\n\n    int firstCompleteIndex(vector<int>& arr, vector<vector<int>>& mat) {\n       int n = mat.size();\n       int m = mat[0].size();\n\n       vector<pairing>markings(m*n+1);\n\n       vector<int>row(n,0);\n       vector<int>col(m,0);\n \n       for(int i = 0 ; i<n ;i++)\n        {\n            for(int j =0; j<m; j++)\n            {\n                markings[mat[i][j]] = make_pair(i,j);\n            }\n        }\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<m*n ; i++)\n        {\n            pairing coordinate = markings[arr[i]];\n\n            int x = coordinate.first;\n            int y = coordinate.second;\n\n            row[x]++;\n            col[y]++;\n\n            if(row[x] == m or col[y] == n)\n            {\n                return i;\n            } \n        }\n    return -1; \n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"first-completely-painted-row-or-column","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":420}
